label: SELF-WORTH

cover.headline: 5 boundaries *worth keeping* when dating again
cover.sub: Kind to them, kinder to you.

points.heading: Your time matters
points.body: Last-minute plans every time? You’re allowed to say no.

points.heading: Your pace is yours
points.body: You decide how fast things move, physically and emotionally.
points.panel: “I like you, and I’d like to take this slowly.”

points.heading: Your life stays full
points.body: Keep your friends, plans and hobbies, even when it’s exciting.
points.panel: Keep one standing plan each week that’s just yours.

points.heading: Respect goes both ways
points.body: Teasing that hurts or plans that keep slipping are worth noticing.
points.panel: “That comment didn’t sit well with me.”

points.heading: Your no is enough
points.body: You don’t need a long explanation to decline something.

close.save: Save this before your next date.

caption:
Boundaries aren’t walls. They’re how you stay yourself while getting close to someone new.

After a hard breakup, it’s tempting to bend too much to keep things going. These five are worth holding onto, kindly and calmly. The right person will respect them, and that tells you a lot.

Save this before your next date, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
